decisions.reason: The accent's existing requirement to derive from the Hero V geometry remains valid unchanged; the source requests a Hero V proportion study but establishes no separate accent change.

The existing derivation rule already requires the closing V to follow the Hero V geometry. The source refines the master Hero V study without changing that rule or independently specifying the closing V.
The source discusses the arms, stance, and silhouette of the Hero V, not the deferred E and L letterforms.
The source reiterates the existing long-term role of the champagne finish but does not change its attributes or resume the deferred material-treatment work.
Hero V curvature and proportion exploration does not alter the deferred requirement for cohesive full-wordmark kerning.
The source does not change the closing V's subordinate visual prominence relative to the Hero V; it only requests further exploration of the Hero V silhouette.
Although the client explains the reasoning behind the requested refinement, the source does not modify the freelancer's obligation to include design rationale with review rounds.
The Hero V design refinement has no effect on acceptable proof attachment formats.
